== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Mu Enkai, also known as Enkai, is a man whose status and ambition were transformed by the discovery of a mysterious egg. This object provides him with immense power, strengthening his physical durability to the point where his skin and bones possess the resilience of leather and [[stone]]. Through [[the egg]], he accesses various techniques, including [[Striker]]-class fireballs that manifest as [[blood]]-red flames. His newfound strength allowed him to command several [[Highgold|Highgolds]], who represent different [[Paths]], and elevated his standing significantly. However, Enkai's temperament is characterized by volatility, pride, and intense rage. During a confrontation with a [[Skysworn]] servant, his anger led him to use his abilities aggressively. Despite the empowerment granted by [[the egg]], Enkai was ultimately killed by a black fire attack, leaving behind nothing but ashes.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|He bears a [[Goldsign]] on the back of his hand consisting of a shifting flame pattern. This mark has been stained red with [[blood]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|A former [[Lowgold]] and servant, he is driven by a deep hatred for the [[Skysworn]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|He originally followed a fire [[Path]] to operate a [[Furnace|furnace]]. His fireball [[technique]] has since evolved into a true weapon due to [[the egg]].}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Born as a servant, Mu Enkai originally followed a fire [[Path]] to manage a [[Furnace|furnace]]. Having previously been a [[Lowgold]], he now bears a [[Goldsign]] on the back of his hand consisting of a shifting flame pattern stained red like [[blood]]. His fireball [[technique]] has since evolved into a true weapon thanks to the influence of [[the egg]]. Throughout his journey, Enkai maintains a deep hatred for the [[Skysworn]].}}
